explanation: The English article on the war of 1965 gives the defeat of 1962 as part of what made Pakistan think the moment had come: after its success in the Rann of Kutch, Pakistan under Ayub Khan "believed the Indian Army would be unable to defend itself against a quick military campaign in the disputed territory of Kashmir as the Indian military had suffered a loss to China in 1962 in the Sino-Indian War". The claim is about a belief the article attributes to the Pakistani leadership, which is why the type is `enabled` and the confidence `probable`.
